create_multi_stage_trainer: create a MultiStageTrainer with a list of ReAgentLightningModule trainers and epoch counts for each stage
configure_optimizers_multi_stage: configure optimizers by chaining optimizers from all stage trainers into a single list
run_training_step_multi_stage: run a training step that delegates to the active stage trainer based on the current epoch
set_reporter_multi_stage: set a CompoundReporter on the MultiStageTrainer to assign individual reporters to each stage trainer
test_multi_stage_trainer: test all stage trainers by running test_step on each and aggregating results by trainer index
